title: Multisite phosphorylation by Cdk1 initiates delayed negative feedback to control mitotic transcription.
authors: Asfaha, Jonathan B; Ord, Mihkel; Carlson, Christopher R; Faustova, Ilona; Loog, Mart; Morgan, David O
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Cdk1对转录共激活因子Ndd1的多位点磷酸化调控有丝分裂转录，属于细胞周期信号传导，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Cell-cycle progression is driven by the phosphorylation of cyclin-dependent kinase (Cdk) substrates.(1-3) The order of substrate phosphorylation depends in part on the general rise in Cdk activity during the cell cycle,(4-7) together with variations in substrate docking to sites on associated cyclin and Cks subunits.(3)(,)(6)(,)(8-10) Many substrates are modified at multiple sites to provide more complex regulation.(10-14) Here, we describe an elegant regulatory circuit based on multisite phosphorylation of Ndd1, a transcriptional co-activator of budding yeast genes required for mitotic progression.(11)(,)(12) As cells enter mitosis, Ndd1 phosphorylation by Cdk1 is known to promote mitotic cyclin (CLB2) gene transcription, resulting in positive feedback.(13-16) Consistent with these findings, we show that low Cdk1 activity promotes CLB2 expression at mitotic entry. We also find, however, that when high Cdk1 activity accumulates in a mitotic arrest, CLB2 expression is inhibited. Inhibition is accompanied by Ndd1 degradation, and we present evidence that degradation is triggered by multisite Ndd1 phosphorylation by high mitotic Cdk1-Clb2 activity. Complete Ndd1 phosphorylation by Clb2-Cdk1-Cks1 requires the phosphothreonine-binding site of Cks1, as well as a recently identified phosphate-binding pocket on the cyclin Clb2.(17) We therefore propose that initial phosphorylation by Cdk1 primes Ndd1 for delayed secondary phosphorylation at suboptimal sites that promote degradation. Together, our results suggest that rising levels of mitotic Cdk1 activity act at multiple phosphorylation sites on Ndd1, first triggering rapid positive feedback and then promoting delayed negative feedback, resulting in a pulse of mitotic gene expression.
abstract_zh: 细胞周期进程由细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶（Cdk）底物的磷酸化驱动。(1-3) 底物磷酸化的顺序部分取决于细胞周期中Cdk活性的总体上升，(4-7) 以及底物与相关细胞周期蛋白和Cks亚基上位点对接的差异。(3)(,)(6)(,)(8-10) 许多底物在多个位点被修饰，以提供更复杂的调控。(10-14) 在此，我们描述了一个基于Ndd1多位点磷酸化的优雅调控回路，Ndd1是芽殖酵母有丝分裂进程所需基因的转录共激活因子。(11)(,)(12) 当细胞进入有丝分裂时，已知Cdk1对Ndd1的磷酸化促进有丝分裂细胞周期蛋白（CLB2）基因的转录，从而产生正反馈。(13-16) 与这些发现一致，我们显示低Cdk1活性在有丝分裂进入时促进CLB2表达。然而，我们也发现，当高Cdk1活性在有丝分裂阻滞中积累时，CLB2表达受到抑制。抑制伴随Ndd1降解，我们提供的证据表明，降解由高有丝分裂Cdk1-Clb2活性对Ndd1的多位点磷酸化触发。Clb2-Cdk1-Cks1对Ndd1的完全磷酸化需要Cks1的磷酸苏氨酸结合位点，以及最近在细胞周期蛋白Clb2上鉴定的磷酸结合口袋。(17) 因此，我们提出，Cdk1的初始磷酸化使Ndd1为在次优位点的延迟二次磷酸化做好准备，从而促进降解。总之，我们的结果表明，有丝分裂Cdk1活性水平的上升作用于Ndd1的多个磷酸化位点，首先触发快速正反馈，然后促进延迟负反馈，导致有丝分裂基因表达的脉冲。
